name: Night City
note: Fan work: a coastal cyberpunk megacity drawing on Blade Runner's Los Angeles and on Cyberpunk's Night City, rendered by the same engine as chicago.html. Nothing is surveyed and no game or film assets are used - tools/make-nightcity.py generates nightcity-osm.json from a seed and every shape is modelled from scratch here. Blade Runner belongs to its rights holders and Night City to CD Projekt Red. Positions are [lat, lon] against the arbitrary projection origin below.
attribution: Night City is fan work: geometry generated by tools/make-nightcity.py. No game or film assets used.

neon._: the night stage: facade signage, billboards, holograms, flying traffic, flare stacks, steam and rain

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

el._: the Coast Line runs on a viaduct above the shore road

landmarks.name: Tyrell Ziggurat, North
landmarks.info: The corporate pyramid. Seven hundred metres of terraces, its own weather at the top, and a view down onto a city that never sees the sun.

landmarks.name: Tyrell Ziggurat, South
landmarks.info: Its twin, set slightly back. Between them the landing decks run day and night.

landmarks.name: Corporate Plaza
landmarks.info: A levelled deck of poured concrete at the foot of the core towers, and the only open ground for a kilometre.

landmarks.name: The Sea Wall
landmarks.info: Two hundred and eight metres of battered concrete along the whole shore, buttressed out into the water, with a road on top and the sluice towers along it. The Pacific stands ninety-five metres above the city behind it. Nobody who lives here has seen the sea.

landmarks.name: The Stacks
landmarks.info: Megablock housing: one slab to a city block, each of them a postcode with a lift queue.

landmarks.name: Ring Freeway
landmarks.info: The elevated ring, up on its piers above the roofs of the low city. Nothing at street level crosses it.

landmarks.name: The Flats
landmarks.info: The industrial plain to the south-east, where the flare stacks burn off whatever is being made out there.

landmarks.name: Dock Yards
landmarks.info: The sea wall, the cranes and the sheds. Everything that arrives in Night City arrives here first.

landmarks.name: Coast Terminal
landmarks.info: Where the Coast Line comes in off the viaduct.

landmarks.name: Reclamation Park
landmarks.info: Planted on fill in a decade when somebody still thought it was worth doing.
